authority.statement: The notice and locator grant no permission or authority.

boundaries: Treat the prototype as candidate-local implementation evidence only; do not describe it as formal design or plan acceptance, synchronized lifecycle state, publication, release, deployment, or production readiness.
Do not infer cross-repository ownership or place private DomainSpec or cyberAlchemy-v2 prose in public Arcanum.
Do not commit, push, publish, deploy, modify Git configuration or index state, or delete node_modules under this notice.
Preserve unrelated dirty bytes, existing submodule boundaries, package lockfile authorities, and exact pilot source state.
The notice and locator are communication evidence only and grant no authority beyond the user's separately stated prototype authorization.
key_points: The bounded prototype scope is a root Node 26.8.1 and TypeScript 7.0.2 toolchain/configuration authority with pilots in projects/auth-user-management and cyberAlchemy-v2/implementation/ontology-evidence-workbench.
The selected Node execution direction is TypeScript source compiled by tsc to JavaScript and then executed by Node; tsx and other direct TypeScript runners are transitional rather than authoritative.
The user authorized local prototype implementation and validation but explicitly asked to defer governance choreography.

Formal design and plan receipts, lifecycle reconciliation, cross-repository or public package placement, acceptance, publication, commits, pushes, deployment, and deletion of node_modules are not part of the prototype authority.

Resolve canonical package ownership and the public/private reuse boundary before promoting shared configuration beyond the bounded pilots.
If continuation is selected, author fresh design and plan artifacts, bind exact candidate bytes, run independent review, and obtain any required acceptance before publication or deployment.
